fields.description: Whether the implementation adds constraints, contributes objective terms, both, or neither. Synced from code for Built-in rules; declared by the developer for Custom Code.
fields.label: Rule Kind

fields.description: Optional heading this rule is filed under in Optimizer Studio's rule panel. Presentational only — it does not affect which rules may be combined. Synced from code for Built-in rules.
fields.label: Topic

fields.description: Set automatically. Only implemented rules can be used in an Optimization Ruleset at solve time.
fields.label: Implemented

fields.description: A developer has reviewed this implementation (e.g. after LLM generation). Custom code only runs once validated; editing the code clears this flag.
fields.label: Validated by Developer

fields.description: Natural-language statement of the rule, precise enough for a developer (or LLM) to implement it later.
fields.label: Description (Natural Language)

fields.description: Key of a rule registered in autoshift.optimizer.rules.BUILTIN_RULES (rule ships in the app code).
fields.label: Built-in Key

fields.description: Python source defining apply(ctx). ctx is autoshift.optimizer.rules.RuleContext with prob (pulp.LpProblem), x (binary vars keyed by (employee, shift, day, branch)), active_rooms (integer vars keyed by (discipline, shift, day, branch)) and data (DataPackage). Add constraints to ctx.prob and/or contribute maximized objective terms via ctx.add_objective(expr) (scaled by the ruleset row weight). pulp and itertools are pre-imported.
fields.label: Implementation Code
